description: NaRb₃H₄ crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. The structure consists of one Na cluster inside a Rb₃H₄ framework. In the Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the Rb₃H₄ framework, Rb is bonded to six H atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing RbH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rb-H bond lengths are 2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent Rb atoms. In the second H site, H is bonded to six equivalent Rb atoms to form corner-sharing HRb₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
